title: Cornercopia Vacation Rental
meta_description: Cornercopia is a 5.00 bedroom, 5.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description Cornercopia, located at 728 Western Lake Drive, is more than a vacation home. It is a WaterColor retreat in the sought-after Park District, designed for families and friends who value comfort, charm, and convenience. With five bedrooms, a private carriage house, and wraparound porches shaded by oaks, the home balances classic Southern architecture with coastal elegance.Property Highlights Exclusive Access to the WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pools With Up to 11 Passes Included 6 Adult Bikes for Effortless Exploring 6-Passenger Street-Legal Golf Cart Included Private Carriage House with Queen Suite and Kitchenette Large Wraparound Porches and Screened Balconies for Outdoor Living Propane Grill, Plus a Built-In Ice Maker Private Corner Lot with Shaded Surroundings Exterior Shower for Easy Beach Days Parking for Up to 5 Vehicles Steps Away From the Seaside Connector Path 3-Minute Bike Ride to WaterColor Beach Club 4-Minute Bike Ride to Camp WaterColor 5-Minute Golf Cart Ride to Seaside Experience the Home Inside, the open living and dining spaces create a natural gathering place. The kitchen is fully equipped with stainless steel appliances, granite counters, a large island, and a built-in ice maker perfect for family cooking or prepping for a day at the beach. Upstairs, three guest suites and a loft provide plenty of space for both privacy and connection, while the carriage house offers complete independence with its own suite, kitchenette, and twin sleeper sofa. Outside, wraparound porches and screened balconies blur the line between home and neighborhood. Begin the day with coffee on the porch, shaded by oaks, and end it with a family dinner as the grill sizzles and the ceiling fans stir a coastal breeze. Exploring is effortless with six adult bikes and a six passenger golf cart included. Ride down shaded paths to Camp WaterColor, pedal to the Beach Club in just minutes, or take the Seaside connector path, steps from the home, for a direct walk or bike ride into Seaside.Sleeping Arrangements First Floor: Master Bedroom: King Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower and Soaking Tub Kitchen Dining Area Living Room Half Bath Laundry Room Second Floor: Guest Bedroom: King Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Guest Bedroom: Two Queen Beds (4), Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Access to Screened Balcony with Outdoor Seating Carriage House: Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed (2), Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo Living Area with Twin Sleeper Sofa (1) Kitchenette Life in WaterColor Cornercopia is set on Western Lake Drive in WaterColor’s Park District, one of the community’s most convenient locations. From here, you’re just minutes from the private Beach Club with its Gulf-front pools, dining, and beach access, and a quick ride to Camp WaterColor, where families love the pools and slides. The community also offers quiet neighborhood pools, tennis and pickleball courts, and the Boathouse, where you can kayak or paddleboard on Western Lake. With Seaside only five minutes away by golf cart, or just steps away through the connector path, you are perfectly positioned between the resort style amenities of WaterColor and one of 30A’s most iconic towns.
